_about: Jolly Jars remote settings. The game checks this file about twice a day. Change a number and save; delete a line to go back to the game's own value; set enabled to false to ignore the whole file. Difficulty values (colors_..., boss_..., empty_jars, min_solution_moves) apply from the next launch; everything else straight away. capacity, star factors and the advent calendar settings can't be changed here. interstitial_after_minutes: an ad can also show after 1 level once this many minutes have passed since the last ad (0 turns it off).
